title: Bank account
description:
Write a class `BankAccount` that stores a balance in whole **cents** and never lets it go negative.

| Member | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `bool deposit(long long cents)` | adds the amount and returns `true`; an amount of zero or less is refused (returns `false`, balance unchanged) |
| `bool withdraw(long long cents)` | takes the amount out and returns `true`; refused if the amount is zero or less, or more than the balance |
| `long long balance() const` | the balance in cents |
| `int transactions() const` | how many deposits and withdrawals have **succeeded** |

A new account has a balance of 0.
hints: Check first, change second: in `withdraw`, refuse `cents <= 0` and `cents > m_balance` before touching anything.
Count a transaction only on the paths that succeed, right next to the line that changes the balance.
